title: Search Capability Library
name: search_capabilities
description: Search the local workspace-first capability library for reusable skills, tools, knowledge, identities, and DAG Harnesses. Use this before inventing a capability or child Agent. Results include a compact reuse contract: executable capabilities can be activated, identities can bind to slots, and Harnesses can be invoked as child sessions or inserted as SubDAG nodes.

query.description: What capability is needed, using a concise task description or keywords.

mode.description: auto/hybrid fuse keyword and vector rankings; semantic uses vectors only; lexical never loads an embedding model.

author: EgoAgent
